new_relations.title: House can mediate presence without containing the source
new_relations.project_anchor: The project distinguishes House as relational architecture from the claim that a local container exhausts what it represents.
new_relations.biblical_structure: Solomon dedicates the temple while saying even heaven cannot contain God, much less the house he built
new_relations.source_direction: Project House/presence distinction first; 1 Kings countertext added later.
new_relations.mismatch: The passage concerns Israel's temple and divine transcendence, not a modern architecture model.
